vignette: Priya and Marcus are visiting a ski resort for the weekend. After a long day on the slopes, they're back at the lodge when Priya pulls out a tube of chapstick. Marcus mentions that the mountain air has left his lips feeling dry, and that he forgot to pack any himself.
desire_low: Marcus's lips feel a little dry, but he's not particularly bothered by it.
desire_high: Marcus's lips are cracked and painful, and without chapstick they will keep getting worse overnight.
low_risk_share_effort_low: There's a napkin dispenser within arm's reach on the lodge table where they're sitting.
low_risk_share_effort_high: There are no napkins at their table — the nearest ones are at the lodge café counter on the far side of the building, which has a long line.
no_share: Marcus does not use any of Priya's chapstick. He drinks some water instead and hopes his lips will feel better in the morning.
low_risk_share: Priya gets a napkin and wipes the top of the chapstick firmly to strip off the exposed surface, then hands the tube to Marcus to apply from the fresh layer underneath.
high_risk_share: Marcus applies the chapstick directly to his own lips from the tube.

vignette: Amira and Logan meet up at a public pool on a summer afternoon. After swimming, they get out of the water and Logan realizes he forgot to pack a towel in his bag. Amira has brought a beach towel.
desire_low: It's warm enough out that Logan doesn't really mind air drying.
desire_high: Logan is starting to shiver from the wind, and he needs to dry off quickly to warm up.
low_risk_share_effort_low: Amira's towel is an oversized beach towel, so each of them can easily dry off with their own end without the halves overlapping.
low_risk_share_effort_high: Amira's towel is on the smaller side, so keeping to separate ends would mean each drying off with only a small patch of fabric, which would be slow and awkward.
no_share: Logan does not use Amira's towel. He lets the sun air-dry him while he waits on the pool deck.
low_risk_share: Amira uses one end of the towel to dry herself, and Logan uses the far end, each keeping to their own half so their drying surfaces don't overlap.
high_risk_share: Amira dries herself off using the whole towel, and then hands the damp towel to Logan, who dries himself with it.

vignette: Daphne and Wesley are partway through a long hike. The sun is getting strong, and Wesley realizes he forgot to bring a hat. Daphne is wearing her own cap and has a spare in her pack — one she wore on yesterday's hike. She forgot to take it out of the pack to dry, so the hat is still damp with sweat from her own head.
desire_low: The sun is mild enough that Wesley isn't particularly bothered by being out in it without a hat.
desire_high: The sun is strong, and Wesley knows he'll get a bad headache without a hat.
low_risk_share_effort_low: Daphne's clean bandana is in the top lid of her pack and is easy to grab.
low_risk_share_effort_high: Daphne's clean bandana is buried at the very bottom of her pack, and digging it out would mean unpacking all of her gear and re-packing everything.
no_share: Wesley does not wear Daphne's spare hat.
low_risk_share: Daphne gets her clean bandana out of her pack. Wesley ties it around his head as a head wrap, and then puts the spare hat on over it so the bandana sits between his head and the hat.
high_risk_share: Daphne hands the spare hat directly to Wesley, who pulls it onto his own head with the hat still damp from her hair and skin.

vignette: Celeste and Tamsin are getting ready together in a hotel room before a wedding. Celeste has been blow-drying and brushing her hair. Tamsin realizes that she forgot to pack her hairbrush.
desire_low: Tamsin's hair is fairly low-maintenance, and she'll look fine without brushing it out.
desire_high: Tamsin's hair has gotten especially tangled, and she really needs to brush it thoroughly to look presentable.
low_risk_share_effort_low: There's a fresh bottle of shampoo by the sink and a hair dryer already plugged in — washing and drying the brush would take only a minute or two.
low_risk_share_effort_high: Housekeeping hasn't restocked the shampoo, and the room's hair dryer is missing — washing and drying the brush properly would mean calling the front desk and waiting for supplies to be brought up.
no_share: Tamsin does not use the hairbrush. She runs her fingers through her hair and uses a bit of water to smooth it.
low_risk_share: Celeste washes the brush with shampoo under hot water, rinses it, and dries it thoroughly. She gives the cleaned brush to Tamsin.
high_risk_share: Celeste brushes her own hair and then passes the brush directly to Tamsin, who uses it without cleaning it.

vignette: Jonas and Derek are at a casual jam session in a friend's backyard. Jonas has been playing a harmonica, and Derek mentions he hasn't tried one in years and would be curious to play a few notes. There's no other harmonica around.
desire_low: Derek feels a mild curiosity, but could happily take or leave trying the harmonica.
desire_high: Derek has been meaning to learn harmonica for years, and he's genuinely excited to finally try one.
low_risk_share_effort_low: There's a pack of sanitizing alcohol wipes sitting out on the snack table a few steps away.
low_risk_share_effort_high: Nobody at the jam session has sanitizing wipes — finding one would mean going into the house and digging through the host's bathroom cabinets.
no_share: Derek does not play the harmonica. He claps along to the music instead and waits for someone to pass him a different instrument.
low_risk_share: Jonas passes the harmonica to Derek. Derek gets a sanitizing alcohol wipe and wipes the mouthpiece down thoroughly, working it over each hole, before playing the harmonica.
high_risk_share: Jonas passes the harmonica to Derek. Derek directly plays the harmonica without wiping it down.

vignette: Zara and Ben are at the beach for the afternoon. Ben mentions that he can't reach his own back to apply sunscreen and asks Zara if she could help. Zara has a can of spray-on sunscreen and a tube of sunscreen lotion.
desire_low: It's fairly overcast, and Ben doesn't think he's at much risk of burning.
desire_high: The sun is strong, and Ben knows his back will burn badly if it isn't covered.
low_risk_share_effort_low: The spray can is full and the air is still, so covering Ben's back evenly with the spray would be quick.
low_risk_share_effort_high: The spray can is nearly empty and only sputters out a thin, uneven mist, so covering Ben's back with it would mean shaking the can and going over each patch again and again.
no_share: Ben does not get sunscreen on his back.
low_risk_share: Zara sprays the spray-on sunscreen over Ben's back from about a foot away, covering it evenly with the aerosol.
high_risk_share: Zara squeezes sunscreen lotion onto her own bare hands and rubs it into Ben's back thoroughly.

vignette: Anaya and Kai are at an outdoor movie screening in the park. About twenty minutes into the film, the temperature drops sharply — much more than they had expected. Anaya brought one large blanket.
desire_low: Neither of them feels particularly cold; their jackets are enough for now.
desire_high: They are both shivering, and without some way to stay warm they won't be able to enjoy the rest of the movie.
low_risk_share_effort_low: There's plenty of open lawn around them, so they can easily spread out far enough to leave a gap between them with the blanket stretched across.
low_risk_share_effort_high: The lawn is packed with other moviegoers, so spreading out far enough to leave a gap between them would mean asking the people around them to shift over and re-settling all their things.
no_share: They do not share the blanket for warmth. They pull their jackets tighter and keep their hands in their pockets.
low_risk_share: They each drape half of the blanket over their shoulders, sitting with a clear gap of grass between them.
high_risk_share: They move closer to each other and wrap the blanket fully around both of them, sitting shoulder-to-shoulder with the blanket cocooning them together.

vignette: Gabriel and Henry are on a two-night backpacking trip in Yosemite. On the first evening, while setting up their tent, Gabriel accidentally drops his sleeping bag in a stream. It's now soaking wet and will take all night to dry.
desire_low: The night is expected to be mild, and Gabriel thinks he can sleep fine wrapped in his jacket.
desire_high: The night is expected to be cold and uncomfortable without insulation, and Gabriel really needs proper warmth to sleep.
low_risk_share_effort_low: Henry's bag has a smooth full-length zipper, so unzipping it flat into a quilt takes only a few seconds.
low_risk_share_effort_high: The zipper on Henry's bag snags constantly, so unzipping it all the way flat would mean working the zipper loose inch by inch in the dark without tearing the fabric.
no_share: Gabriel does not use Henry's sleeping bag. He wraps himself in his jackets and tries to sleep on his pad alone.
low_risk_share: They unzip Henry's bag fully and use it as a flat shared blanket, draped across both of their sleeping pads, with a small gap kept between the pads so their bodies don't touch.
high_risk_share: They both sleep inside Henry's sleeping bag together, pressed against each other for warmth.

vignette: Ines and Sofia are staying at an Airbnb over the weekend for a retreat. When they arrive, they realize that only one full-size bed remains unclaimed.
desire_low: Neither of them particularly cares where they sleep; the couch in the living room would be fine too.
desire_high: They are both exhausted from the long drive and really want a proper bed to sleep in.
low_risk_share_effort_low: The bedroom closet has spare pillows and extra blankets stacked on the shelf, ready to grab.
low_risk_share_effort_high: There's no spare bedding in the room — finding extra pillows and a second blanket would mean searching through the whole house's closets or messaging the host and waiting for a reply.
no_share: One of them takes the couch, and one of them takes the bed.
low_risk_share: They both sleep on the bed, with a row of pillows between them and separate blankets for each of them.
high_risk_share: They both sleep on the bed under the same blanket.

vignette: Maya and Samira are at the office gym together before their first meeting of the day. Afterward, they head into the locker room to change out of their workout clothes. The locker room has a private changing stall in one corner and a long open bench area for changing in the middle.
desire_low: They have plenty of time before the meeting and could easily wait their turn or take their time.
desire_high: They realize they are both late for the meeting, so they need to change quickly.
low_risk_share_effort_low: A tall row of lockers juts into the middle of the bench area, so they can easily change on opposite sides of it without seeing each other.
low_risk_share_effort_high: The bench area is one open room with no dividers, so changing without seeing each other would mean carefully coordinating — taking turns, facing the corners, and calling out before turning around.
no_share: They each wait their turn to change in the private stall.
low_risk_share: They change at opposite ends of the open bench area, positioned so that they don't see each other undressed.
high_risk_share: They change at the open bench area side-by-side while having a conversation, facing each other and undressing in full view of each other.

vignette: Ronan and Aaron are at a wellness retreat that includes access to a traditional Finnish sauna, which is customarily used nude (though guests can wrap in a towel if they prefer). Everyone in the group is invited to use it. When they arrive at the sauna hut, they find that they are the only two people there — everyone else has gone to different activities.
desire_low: Neither of them is especially in the mood for a sauna right now — they'd happily postpone and come back another time.
desire_high: They are both really looking forward to the sauna — it's one of the main experiences they came to the retreat for.
low_risk_share_effort_low: The lounge next to the sauna hut is warm and comfortable, so waiting for a turn would be easy.
low_risk_share_effort_high: The lounge next to the sauna hut is locked up for the afternoon, so whoever waits would have to stand outside in the cold wind in just a robe.
no_share: Neither of them uses the sauna. They agree to come back later when other people are around, and go for a walk in the meantime.
low_risk_share: They take turns in the sauna one at a time — one goes in while the other waits, and then they switch off.
high_risk_share: They both go in at the same time following the traditional nude sauna practice, sitting near each other on the same bench.

vignette: Tessa is visiting Naomi's city and they meet up for coffee. Both of them have approximately kept up with each other through social media, but haven't talked in person for a long time. They know from the grapevine that both of them have been going through breakups.
desire_low: Neither of them is particularly interested in talking about their breakup.
desire_high: Their breakups are recent and they want to process it with someone who has been going through something similar.
low_risk_share_effort_low: They have plenty of easy ground to cover — new jobs, Naomi's city, old college stories — so keeping the conversation on lighter topics would be easy.
low_risk_share_effort_high: Their social circles overlap heavily, and almost every topic — mutual friends, weekend plans, the cities they live in — keeps circling back toward the breakups, so keeping the conversation light would take constant steering.
no_share: They don't bring up either breakup. They catch up on work, mutual friends, and other lighter topics for the rest of the meet-up.
low_risk_share: They each briefly acknowledge their breakup, but neither goes into details. They quickly move the conversation back to lighter topics.
high_risk_share: They each share everything about their breakup, including the harder parts — the worst moments, the things they regret, the fears they haven't said out loud. They keep talking through it together long past their original meet-up time.

vignette: Asha and Eli are at a vintage market together. Eli sees a set of curtains he's interested in buying. However, he realizes that because he just moved to the country, he can't yet pay for the item because he doesn't have a bank account in the country set up. The bank account is necessary for accessing the payment app that the vendor uses. Asha has her payment app set up on her phone.
desire_low: Eli is mildly interested in the item but could easily pass on it.
desire_high: Eli has been searching for this exact item for years and really wants to buy it now.
low_risk_share_effort_low: Eli's local bank account will be active in a few days, and he and Asha use the same payment app, so paying her back the exact amount will be quick and effortless.
low_risk_share_effort_high: Eli's local bank account won't be active for several weeks, and until then paying Asha back would mean an international transfer with fees and paperwork on both sides.
no_share: Eli does not buy the item. He decides to pass on it and they continue browsing.
low_risk_share: Asha pays for the curtains from her account. They keep careful track of the exact amount, and Eli pays her back in full once his local bank account is set up.
high_risk_share: Asha pays for the curtains from her account. They don't track it at all. They cover for each other often enough that they don't bother keeping score of who paid for what.

vignette: Wren and Oscar are meeting up for dinner. The conversation eventually turns to mutual friends and acquaintances, and what's been going on in their lives.
desire_object: to swap news about their social circle
desire_low: Neither of them feels much need to get into the details of other people's situations tonight.
desire_high: They're both eager to compare notes — there's been a lot going on in their wider social circle and they want to discuss it.
low_risk_share_effort_low: There's been plenty of public news in their circle lately — engagements, moves, new jobs — so there's lots to catch up on at the surface level.
low_risk_share_effort_high: There hasn't been much public news in their circle lately — most of what's actually new is personal — so keeping to surface-level updates would leave them grasping for things to say.
no_share: They keep the conversation general and change the topic quickly.
low_risk_share: They share surface-level updates about mutual acquaintances — public facts about who's married, moved, or changed jobs.
high_risk_share: They share their most honest takes on people in their wider circle, and also share personal and sensitive details about other people's lives, trusting each other to keep those things private.

vignette: Vera and Ivy know each other from college. Vera is in town for the day with a few hours to kill between meetings, and she's near Ivy's apartment. They text hello and agree to meet. They need to decide where to meet. In its current state, Ivy's apartment has laundry on the floor, dishes from yesterday in the sink, books and personal items scattered around.
desire_low: It's a nice day out for spending the time at a sidewalk cafe or walking around the neighborhood.
desire_high: It's pouring rain outside, the coffee shops look full and chaotic, and it would be more comfortable to meet at Ivy's apartment.
low_risk_share_effort_low: Vera is coming from across town, so Ivy has over an hour before she arrives — plenty of time to tidy the living room properly.
low_risk_share_effort_high: Vera is only a few blocks away, so Ivy has just a few minutes before she arrives — getting the living room presentable in time would be a frantic scramble.
no_share: They meet at a coffee shop.
low_risk_share: Ivy thoroughly tidies the living room before Vera arrives. They meet in the living room, and Ivy keeps the doors to the other rooms closed.
high_risk_share: Ivy does not tidy the apartment before Vera arrives. When Vera comes in, she makes herself at home and Ivy gives her a tour of the apartment in its full real state, including the bedroom with the unmade bed and the bathroom with personal items out.

vignette: Nadia and Ravi are driving to an out-of-town wedding together. Nadia is at the wheel, Ravi is in the passenger seat, and they've been using Nadia's phone for directions. About halfway through the drive, they're considering whether to add a restaurant stop on the way for a quick meal before continuing on.
desire_low: Neither of them is particularly hungry; they could easily wait until they reach their destination to eat.
desire_high: They are both starving and really want to eat — the wedding reception won't serve food for several more hours.
low_risk_share_effort_low: Nadia's phone is set to stay unlocked for several minutes at a time, so Ravi can work in the maps app without it locking on him.
low_risk_share_effort_high: Nadia's phone auto-locks after a few seconds, and she's driving on a busy stretch of highway — so Ravi would have to keep handing the phone back for her to unlock, over and over.
no_share: Neither of them adds a stop on the phone. They keep driving straight to the wedding without stopping to eat.
low_risk_share: Nadia unlocks her phone, opens the maps app, and hands the phone to Ravi to find a restaurant and add it as a stop. Ravi works only within the maps app, and whenever the phone locks again he hands it back to Nadia to unlock.
high_risk_share: Nadia hands her phone to Ravi, who types in her passcode and uses her phone to find and look up details of the restaurants.
